entities.summary: Karlos May Nasar is a Bulgarian weightlifter who is an Olympic, three-time World and three-time European champion and one of the youngest weightlifting world record holders ever. He was named Bulgaria's Sportsman of the Year for 2024 and 2025. Nasar also received the 2024 and 2025 Ikarus Sports Award.
